property_summary: For every call, C.version() must return the exact string "1.0.0"; the mutant returns a different string (e.g. "1.0.0+meta") for some inputs, so the property is violated.
change_summary: Change returned version string from "1.0.0" to "1.0.0+meta".
mutated_unit_code: function version() external pure returns (string memory) { return "1.0.0+meta"; }
